landing.modes_lead: Start relaxed, race the clock, see how long you last, or guess which country has more people. Play all {{total}} UN member states, or just one continent.
landing.daily_rule: {{count}} flags, the same for everyone today. One try.
landing.how_step1_body: Each day brings a new set of {{count}} flags. Everyone playing on the same date gets the same ones.
landing.how_step2_body: Your first attempt is the one that counts. Answer fast: quick answers earn bonus points.
landing.how_step3_body: Share your result grid without spoilers, and come back tomorrow to grow your streak.
landing.faq_q1: Which countries are in the game?
landing.faq_a1: All {{total}} member states of the United Nations. Quiz their flags, capitals or shapes, and limit a Round to one continent if you like.
landing.faq_a2: Each correct answer earns base points, plus a bonus for answering fast. A streak of correct answers multiplies your points.
landing.faq_a3: Every country you answer correctly in a Flags quiz is collected in your Passport. Answer it right three times to master it.
landing.faq_a4: No. Your bests, Passport and Achievements are saved on this device only.
landing.faq_q5: Can I turn off the animations?
landing.faq_a5: Yes. Turn on Reduce motion in Settings, or use your device's reduced motion setting.
landing.cta_body: Pick a mode and see how well you really know the world.
landing.quizzes: Flags, capitals or country shapes: pick what to quiz, then pick how to play.
